name: LWC Test: Intraday Sessions & Price Action
description: LWC chart integration test. Exercises session blocks (RTH/ETH/IB), SMA 20 line, ATR indicator pane, and lazy loading with 1Min data on ES futures.
source:
# =============================================================================
# LWC TEST: INTRADAY SESSIONS & PRICE ACTION
# Tests: Session blocks, SMA 20 overlay, ATR pane, Lazy loading (1Min)
# =============================================================================

src = market_data_source()()

# === CONTINUOUS CONTRACT ===
cont = futures_continuation(s_rollover_method=RolloverType.LiquidityBased, s_adjustment_method=AdjustmentType.NoAdjustment, i_offset=0)(src.o, src.h, src.l, src.c, src.v, src.oi, src.s)
close = cont.c
high = cont.h
low = cont.l
open_price = cont.o
vol = cont.v

# === SESSION WINDOWS ===
rth_sw = session_window(session=SessionType.EquityRTHSession)(open_price, high, low, close)
eth_sw = session_window(session=Session(start='18:00', end='09:30', tz='America/New_York'))(open_price, high, low, close)
ib_sw = session_window(session=Session(start='09:30', end='10:30', tz='America/New_York'))(open_price, high, low, close)

# === SMA 20 (line overlay on price pane) ===
sma_20 = ma(period=20, type=MAType.sma)(close)

# === ATR (separate pane) ===
atr_val = atr(high, low, close, 14)

# === HOLIDAY FILTER ===
is_holiday = holiday(days_before=0, days_after=0, holiday_calendar=HolidayCalendar.CMEGlobexEquitiesHolidayCalendar)
rth_valid = (rth_sw.closed and not is_holiday)

# === OVERNIGHT LEVELS (ffilled through RTH) ===
eth_valid = (eth_sw.closed and not is_holiday)
on_high = ffill(where(eth_valid, eth_sw.high))
on_low = ffill(where(eth_valid, eth_sw.low))

# === IB LEVELS ===
ib_valid = (ib_sw.closed and not is_holiday)
ib_high_level = ffill(where(ib_valid, ib_sw.high))
ib_low_level = ffill(where(ib_valid, ib_sw.low))

# =============================================================================
# REPORTERS
# =============================================================================

# --- SMA 20 on price pane ---
xy_lines(
    title='SMA 20',
    category='Price',
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='SMA 20', color=Color.Orange, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash)
    ])
)(x_values=index(), y_values=sma_20)

# --- Overnight high/low levels on price pane ---
xy_lines(
    title='Overnight Levels',
    category='Price',
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='ON High', color=Color.Purple, dash_style=DashStyle.Dot),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='ON Low', color=Color.Purple, dash_style=DashStyle.Dot)
    ])
)(x_values=index(), y_values=(on_high, on_low))

# --- IB levels on price pane ---
xy_lines(
    title='Initial Balance Levels',
    category='Price',
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='IB High', color=Color.Amber, dash_style=DashStyle.ShortDash),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='IB Low', color=Color.Amber, dash_style=DashStyle.ShortDash)
    ])
)(x_values=index(), y_values=(ib_high_level, ib_low_level))

# --- ATR in separate pane ---
xy_lines(
    title='ATR (14)',
    category='ATR',
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='ATR', color=Color.Blue)
    ])
)(x_values=index(), y_values=atr_val)

# --- Session summary table ---
summary_table(
    mode=TableMode.rowspec,
    layout=SummaryTableLayout(
        title='Session Level Touch Rates',
        row_size=4,
        col_size=1,
        row_headers=['RTH Sessions', 'RTH Touched ON High', 'RTH Touched ON Low', 'RTH Broke IB High'],
        col_headers=['Value'],
        cells=[
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Sum, type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=2, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=3, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1)
        ]
    ),
    category='Session Stats'
)(where(rth_valid, 1.0), where(rth_valid, (1.0 if rth_sw.high >= on_high else 0.0)), where(rth_valid, (1.0 if rth_sw.low <= on_low else 0.0)), where(rth_valid, (1.0 if rth_sw.high > ib_high_level else 0.0)))
